articles.title: Yemen's Houthis say they fired missiles at Saudi forces in Jazan
articles.description: CAIRO, Nov 13 - Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said on Friday they had fired two ballistic missiles at what they described as concentrations of Saudi forces in Al-Tuwal in Jazan province, hours after Saudi civil defence issued an all-clear for the province. Read more at straitstimes.com.
